notes.title: We’re in Save & Sound!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Just writing to let you all know that we are featuring in the Save & Sound showcase on November 4th, where our short film about the making of our soundtrack will be shown at 23:30 CEST/ 14:30 PST! We’re super excited to tell you more about what went into the music for Europa, so be sure to [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fdbYJK4zEr0&t=17218s]tune in here[/url]! You can check out all the other amazing titles in the schedule below as well:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43300502/7c7d3a292f577c6f2302a050284fe8960dfcc2dd.png[/img]

We’re very proud of Europa’s soundtrack, so we’re delighted to be a part of this event. Our composer, Matthew Thomason, has done an incredible job at achieving what we envisioned for the soundtrack, ensuring this emotive adventure would have the perfect accompaniment. We want to say a huge thank you to him and all the musicians who worked on the music: Kath Buckler, Benjamin Sutcliffe and Martin Skews. Your hard work on this passion project of ours is greatly appreciated 💙 

Talk soon and enjoy!

- Helder

notes.title: Gameplay flow & Bugs hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed some areas of the game having sudden stops of momentum, nudged the placement of a few efields (Zephyr refills) and added a few extra as well, to areas that needed it. This, paired up with the new zephyr upgrade tweaks, makes the game feel slightly more airborne.
- Fixed the roman numerals in Final Emerald Altar.
- Fixed an issue where some players had emeralds getting reset. (if first played in the initial release, then played after a patch)
- Other small bug fixes across the levels.
- Fixed a couple map player containment issues.
- Corrected a few lighting bugs in various levels.

notes.title: Our first big update is live, including new ‘Zen Mode’!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Firstly thank you so much to everyone who has bought the game, it’s been a whirlwind first few days!

We’ve been super busy every day since launch watching all your playthroughs, reading all your reports and working up our first big post-launch update for the game!

The first big one to note: we added a “Zen Mode”! This brings a whole new feel to the world of Europa, for any players who just want to move through the world peacefully without any threats. Gardeners won’t attack, turrets won’t shoot at you, mines won’t blow you up - just chill vibes all the way through. We’re really hoping this helps open up the Europa experience to even more players and play styles.



We also added a Chapter select function, so that when you’ve completed the game, you’ll be able to jump back into any levels you like, carrying over your progress from your existing playthrough - Journal, Bestiary and Emerald collections will all carry over. This should be great for any of you hunting down achievements! For the Emerald Collectors in particular, we’ve added some info to the Emerald Room near the end of the game that should give you an idea of where the emeralds you’ve missed might be. When you do jump back into the game, any emeralds you’ve previously collected will now show as greyed out “ghost emeralds” to make it super clear which ones are the ones you’re missing.

On top of this we’ve made a ton of bug fixes, UX improvements, tweaks and polish across the whole game. We’re going to be keeping a very close eye here, on the Steam forums, and on our [url=https://discord.gg/DHqXDahc75]Discord[/url] and will be doing everything we can to make sure we can deliver a great experience for as many of you as possible, so keep your eyes out here for more updates and news very soon!

Thanks so much for all the support through our first few days - it really means the world to us.

Much love, 
-Helder & the Europa team

notes.title: Bug fixes and UX improvement patch
notes.content:
-Fixed some collision inconsistencies.
-Improved the placement of Boom Beetles.
-Extended shot cooldown on Turrets and Boom Beetles by about a second, to avoid player getting suck in a stunned state.
-Fixed achievement not unlocking.
-Better code to Unlock Chapter Select if player finished the game at least once.
-Players can now close the journal by tapping Keyboard Esc or Controller Start.

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content: Fixed a few areas in the maps where Zee could get stuck in.

notes.title: Europa is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello Europians,

The day has finally come… Europa is out NOW!!!

[previewyoutube=BtFY6GEWkAg;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s been a real journey to get to this moment. Ups, downs, plenty of magic, some setbacks and a lot of hard work! It has all been worth it to bring this world to life though. To let you in on the last seven years that I’ve spent working on this passion project, here are some highlights:

[list]
[*]My kids were born!
[*]A pandemic happened.
[*]A few friends came to join the team after a long while of working alone, including publisher Future Friends Games!
[*]After many late nights working on Europa I decided to quit my “proper job” at Blizzard.
[*]I got married!
[*]250k wishlist additions…
[/list]
Now here we are 🥲

Once again, a huge thank you to all who have been a part of this journey. Your feedback, support and excitement is the driving force behind the team's hard work! Now please go, play, explore and get to know the moon of Europa 🌖

Much love,

- Helder

notes.title: Europa release date reveal!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It’s been a little while since I’ve been able to give you an update like this, and I am so thrilled to finally reveal…

🎉 Europa will be yours on October 11th!! 🎉

[previewyoutube=FBhkG9lD11s;full][/previewyoutube]

I have poured absolutely everything into Europa for the last 7 years (wild, right?!) and I can’t wait to show you the world that we’ve built. I want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has supported this journey throughout, all your feedback, kind words and excitement for the project has motivated me so much. I also want to thank the rest of the Europa team for working so hard on this project. Now it’s time to celebrate all your hard work and enjoy!!💙

Talk to you soon and hope you enjoy Europa.

Much love,

- Helder

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
Hi everybody. Helder here, creator of Europa. I’m afraid I have some tough news to share. Though we previously announced that Europa would launch on April 16th, it now looks like we’ll have to delay the launch a little - probably until Summer.


This was a very hard decision and came after a lot of discussion between myself and the rest of the team. Europa began as a side project I created alone, and in the years since it has grown more than I ever could have dreamed, though we are still working in the evenings and weekends around our day jobs. I’m very proud of what we’ve done together - which is why I can’t stand the thought of releasing the game before it’s in the condition we want it to be. Unfortunately, it looks like that’ll take a little bit longer than we expected. I go into a little more detail in the following video: 

[previewyoutube=S5Gc6TDgB_c;full][/previewyoutube]

I know a lot of people have been excited for the launch, and I’d like to apologise, and ask that you kindly hold on just a little longer. I promise the extra time will be well spent, and I really believe the final work will be worth the wait. We’ll let you know the new date as soon as we’re 100% confident we’re ready to launch.


Thank you for all your support and patience - it really does mean the world to us! 


-Helder
